data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 claims the isolated artifact eliminates all non-even-centred triples simultaneously by proving that any valid even triple must be centred on an even mean — a class-level elimination. But the neighbourhood rejection of 45,46,47 is already a parity-of-the-mean check, and extending that check from one instance to the whole class is just scope-widening of the same parity gate, not a distinct relation between artifacts. The 'compatible with but extends to meta level' framing masks that the two are the same mechanism at different granularity; the proposed relation is essentially a restatement of a shared parity constraint, not a substantive connection between the isolated artifact and SRC_002 specifically.
